FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Vacuum Solutions & Repair, we specialize in retail sales of new and refurbished vacuum cleaners, along with a variety of essential accessories such as filters and replacement parts. Our operations include providing in-shop repair and maintenance for residential and light commercial vacuum cleaners, carried out by our certified technicians. We prioritize product quality by sourcing the vacuum cleaners and parts exclusively from reputable manufacturers with proven records. Our staff undergoes thorough safety and technical training, ensuring compliance with all local electrical safety regulations. We also maintain a well-documented safety protocol and quality assurance process to mitigate risks and ensure customer satisfaction. Importantly, we do not engage in any manufacturing or assembly of vacuum cleaners or components, adhering strictly to industry best practices in retail and service operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses reported due to operational adherence to service regulations and quality control; business activities do not involve manufacturing or higher-risk operations.
